name: pptx-presenter
description: 轻量 pptx 编辑与播放器

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/metafile && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w yaokongppt
scripts.test: npm run test -w @genoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @genoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @genoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @genoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @genoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w yaokongppt
scripts.dist:win: npm run build -w yaokongppt && npm run dist:win -w yaokongppt
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build -w yaokongppt && npm run dist:mac -w yaokongppt
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build -w yaokongppt && npm run dist:linux -w yaokongppt
